label: Extended Stiwanist African feminism into decolonial law and Ubuntu ethics
description: Tamale advanced Ogundipe’s call for endogenous African feminist transformation by dismantling colonial penal codes through Ubuntu jurisprudence.
dialecticalTension: Operationalizes Afro-feminist theory inside constitutional and customary law.

label: Applied critique of colonial gnosis to African jurisprudence and sexuality
description: Drawing on Mudimbe’s deconstruction of the colonial library, Tamale showed how Victorian missionary law invented rigid sexual binaries in Africa.
dialecticalTension: Brings archaeological decolonial critique to legal philosophy.
